key_insight: Wishful cryptanalysis pairs exploratory AI reasoning with executable verification to discover cryptanalytic attacks without deferring blindly to prior literature.
engineering_relevance: The methodology offers a harness-agnostic approach to AI-assisted security research that co-adapts cryptographic primitives, attack algorithms, and hardware within provisioned compute.
method: Develop reduced-scale theory with executable witnesses that certify mathematical claims.
Pair constructive optimism with blinded, zero-import verification to catch flawed reasoning.
Co-adapt primitive, algorithm, and hardware, then climb parameter ladders toward higher-round attacks.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports thirteen verifiable practical results across Keccak (SHA-3) and AES using open-weight and proprietary models, including resolution of a fifteen-year-open public challenge.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify attack parameters, compute costs, or verification details; these results should not be read as breaks of full standardized SHA-3 or AES.
paper_title: Do Alice and Bob Dream of the Oracle? Wishful Cryptanalysis
